text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки is the daughter of a famous
stage
actor, but she has chosen to go
down the path of
racing rather than
theater.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her path may be different, but with her
eyes set
on a destination only she can
reach, she is just as
determined to make
her fans proud.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
First on the list is conquering the Classic
Triple
Crown. Then, it's becoming an
unrivaled
entertainer. Фудзи Кисэки's
journey to achieve her
lofty goals starts
now!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
